scope: Same frozen binaries; two wallets per profile; 32 candidates per wallet; 16-candidate admission. Sequential hosted screens with independent deployments. CPU and placement variation remain uncontrolled. Starting and final reserves must balance. No production percentile claim.

preparation_cost.scope: Captured preparer-A producer-alarm invocation wall time during load and full reserve restoration, including failed and recovery invocations. One producer invocation can deliver two independent groups. Invocation time is charged once; peer time is not added. Per-group allocation divides job time equally and is an accounting model. Starting material cancels only when the same candidate reserve is restored and the identity ledger is complete. Missing publication, invocation, and canceled-producer costs remain unknown. These invocation durations include setup and settlement. Queue waits are in the cycle and demand metrics. Worker elapsed_ms is only clock advancement and cannot qualify elapsed preparation time.

fully_measured_fresh_demands.scope: Only successful logical demands whose consumed groups all have matched producer-invocation wall measurements and none came from starting stock. Includes earlier exhausted operations within each demand. This subset excludes unassigned preparation failures and is not the total service cost.
